# PB-0507 static vertical-slice fixture

This fixture is a self-authored, texture-free two-metre cube named `StoneArch`. It exists only to
exercise the static portable pipeline without third-party content. The exported `.fbx` can be
regenerated with the repository-contained approved Blender by running
`generate_fixture.py` in background mode.

The fixture and generator are dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. Blender itself remains
subject to its own licence and is not tracked in this repository.
